title: PROPHESY DIVINE COMPLETION OVER YOUR MORNING
text: I want you to share this prayer with somebody. There is a covenant in sharing. When you share what God is saying, you are not just blessing others. You are positioning yourself for a double portion. The Bible says in Proverbs 11:25, "The liberal soul shall be made fat, and he that waterth shall be watered also himself." So before we go into this realm of prayer and prophetic declaration, I want you to press that share button, send it to your family members, send it to your WhatsApp groups, send it to your colleagues at work. Somebody needs to hear what the spirit of God is saying this morning. There is a prophetic frequency being released and when you share it, you become a carrier of that frequency. You become an extension of the anointing. Glory to God. Now I want you to understand something very critical this morning. The Bible says in Ecclesiastes 3:1 to everything there is a season and a time to every purpose under the heaven. But I want to take you deeper than that scripture. There is a dimension in God where he doesn't just give you seasons. He gives you divine completions. There is a difference between starting something and completing it. Many believers are excellent [music] starters but terrible finishers. They begin with fire. They begin with passion. They begin with zeal. But somewhere along the journey they lose momentum. Somewhere along the journey discouragement sets in. Somewhere along the journey delays become denials in their minds. But I prophesy over your life this morning. Every project that God has begun in your life, every vision he has deposited in your spirit, every assignment he has commissioned you to fulfill, I decree and declare divine completion over it in the mighty name of Jesus. The spirit of God is breathing upon unfinished projects. The spirit of God is breathing upon abandoned dreams. The spirit of God is breathing upon visions that have been on pause. And I hear the Lord saying, "This is your season of divine completion." You see, when we talk about divine completion, we're not talking about human effort. We're not talking about your strength. We're not talking about your wisdom. We're talking about a supernatural intervention where God himself steps into your situation and brings to pass what seems impossible. The Bible says in Philippians 1:6, "Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ." Did you hear that? He that has begun a good work will perform it. The word performed there means to complete, to finish, to bring to full manifestation. I don't know what you have been struggling with. I don't know what has been lingering in your life for years. I don't know what has been moving at a snail's pace, but I want you to receive this prophetic word. God is releasing acceleration over your life this morning. What has taken others years to accomplish, you will accomplish in months. What has taken others months to accomplish, you will accomplish in weeks. There is a divine acceleration being released over your finances, over your ministry, over your career, over your business, over your family. The Lord is compressing time on your behalf. Now let me show you something in the scripture in the book of Zechariah chapter 4 the prophet was shown a vision and in verse 9 the word of the Lord came to him saying the hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house his hands shall also finish it and thou shall know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me unto you. Do you see the prophetic pattern? The same hands that laid the foundation shall finish it. God is saying to someone this morning, what you have started, you will finish. The enemy has been telling you that you won't make it. The enemy has been showing you obstacles. The enemy has been magnifying the challenges. But I prophesy, you will not die in the middle of your assignment. You will not abort your destiny. You will not give up on what God has called you to do. Let me take you to another dimension. In the book of Hagi chapter 1, the people of God had started building the temple, but they abandoned it. They left it incomplete. They got distracted by their own houses, their own comfort, their own agenda. And God sent a prophet to steer them up. God sent a prophet to remind them of their divine assignment. And when they responded to the prophetic word, do you know what happened? The Bible says in Haggi 2:9, "The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, sayeth the [music] Lord of hosts. And in this place will I give peace, sayeth the Lord of hosts. I want you to catch this. When you return to what God called you to complete, when you return to that abandoned project, when you return to that vision that you put on hold, God will make the end greater than the beginning. Your latter shall be greater than your former. This is not motivational speaking. This is prophetic declaration backed by the word of God. Some of you started businesses and they collapsed. Some of you started ministries and they face opposition. Some of you started relationships with God and you backslid. But I hear the spirit of God saying, "Return and I will restore. Return and I will complete what I started." Now, I want to pray with you, but I need you to engage your spirit. I need you to open your mouth. I need you to agree with what the spirit of God is saying. The Bible says in Amos 3:3, "Can two walk together except they be agreed?" So as I pray, I want you to pray with me. I want you to declare with me. I want you to prophesy with me. Are you ready? Father, in the mighty name of Jesus, I come before your throne of grace this morning, lifting up every soul that is hearing this word, I thank you because your [music] word says in Isaiah 55 to11 that your word will not return to you void, but it will accomplish what you please and prosper in the thing [music] whereto you sent it. So I decree that every word being released this morning is spirit and life. It is carrying prophetic accuracy. It is carrying divine power. It is carrying resurrection virtue. And everywhere it lands, it shall produce divine completion in Jesus mighty name. Father I prophesy over every unfinished project. I speak to every abandoned vision. I speak to every delayed promise. I command acceleration in the spirit realm. I decree that what the enemy has delayed, you are releasing double for. The Bible says in Zechariah 9:12, "Turn you to the stronghold. Ye prisoners of hope, even today do I declare that I will render double unto thee." So I declare double restoration. I declare double blessing. I declare double favor. What was stolen is coming back multiplied in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of procrastination, I bind you now. Every spirit of discouragement, I command you to lose your hold. Every spirit of delay, I break your power in the name of Jesus. The Bible says in Isaiah 60-22, "A little one shall become a thousand and a small one a strong nation. I the Lord will hasten it in his time." I decree that this is your time. God is hastening your breakthrough. God is hastening your completion. God is hastening your manifestation. I speak to every financial project that has been stagnant. I command supernatural provision. I decree that heaven's windows are opening over your life. Malachi 3:10 says, "Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse that there may be meat in mine house and prove me now herewith, sayaeth the Lord of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven and pour you out a blessing that there shall not be room enough to receive it. I decree that you are entering a season of overflow, a season of more than enough, a season of abundance. I speak to every academic pursuit that has been delayed, every degree that has been on hold, [music] every certification that has been pending. I decree divine completion. I decree supernatural understanding. I decree that the spirit of wisdom and revelation is resting upon you. Ephesians 1:17 says that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him. I decree clarity of mind. I decree retentive memory. I decree excellence in all your examinations. I prophesy over marriages that have been hanging [music] in the balance, relationships that have been going through turbulence. I decree divine completion. I speak alignment. I speak understanding. I speak covenant love. The Bible says in Ecclesiastes 4:9-12, "Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow. But woe to him that is alone when he fall. For he had not another to help him up." Again, if two lie together, then they have heat. But how can one be warm alone? And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him. And a three-fold cord is not [music] quickly broken. I decree that God is restoring the three-fold cord in your marriage. God himself is becoming the center of your relationship. I speak to ministries that have been facing opposition, callings that have been under attack, assignments that have been resisted by the kingdom of darkness. I decree every opposition is collapsing now. Every barrier is breaking now. Every limitation is being destroyed now. The Bible says in Isaiah 54:17, "No weapon that is formed against thee [music] shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn." This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, sayaeth the Lord. I decree that you are stepping into your heritage. No weapon shall prosper. Every evil tongue is condemned. Now I want you to lift up your right hand. I want you to point it toward heaven. And I want you to decree after me. Father, I receive divine completion over my life. Everything you have started, you will finish. Every word you have spoken, you will fulfill. Every promise you have made, you will accomplish. I am not a victim of delay. I am not a victim of procrastination. I am not a victim of limitation. I am a candidate for divine completion. I am a candidate for supernatural breakthrough. I am a candidate for accelerated manifestation. Now keep your hand lifted. The Bible says in Psalm 90-17, "And let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us and establish thou the work of our hands upon us. Yay, the work of our hands establish thou it." I want you to say, Lord, establish the work of my hands. Let everything I put my hands to prosper. Let every project I start come to divine completion. Let every seed I sow yield a supernatural harvest. Let every prayer I pray receive a divine answer. I am coming out of the season of stagnation. I am entering the season of completion. [music] Let me take you into a deeper dimension. You see, there are some people who don't complete things because they don't have a vision. Proverbs 29-18 says where there is no vision the people perish. The word perish there means to become unrestrained to lose focus [music] to lack direction. But I want you to understand that vision is not just what you see with your physical eyes. Vision is what God has deposited in your spirit. It is the picture of your future that God has painted in your heart. It is the burden that keeps you awake at night. It is the assignment that won't let you rest. It is the thing that makes you uncomfortable with mediocrity. And when you have a clear vision, completion [music] becomes inevitable. Why? Because vision creates passion and passion creates persistence. And persistence guarantees completion. The Bible tells us in Habach 2:22:3, "And the Lord answered me and said, write the vision and make it plain upon tables that [music] he may run that readeth it. For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak and not lie. Though it tar, wait for it, because it will surely come, it will not tarry. Did you catch that? The vision has an appointed time. And even though it may tar, it will surely come. So, I'm prophesying over someone this morning. Your vision has an appointed time. And that appointed time is now. What God showed you years ago is coming to pass now. What God whispered to you in the secret place is manifesting now. What God promised you when nobody believed in you is becoming reality now. Let me give you a practical example from scripture. In Genesis chapter 37, Joseph had a dream. He saw himself [music] in a position of authority. He saw his brothers bowing down to him. He saw himself as a ruler. But between the dream and the fulfillment, there was a prison. Between the vision and the manifestation, there was betrayal. Between the promise and the performance, there was pain. Joseph was thrown into a pit by his own brothers. He was sold into slavery. He was [music] falsely accused of rape. He was thrown into prison. And in that prison, he stayed for years. Now, if Joseph was like many modern believers, he would have said, "God, you lied to me. You showed me a vision, but look where I am. You promised me greatness, but I'm in a dungeon. You said I will rule, but I'm in chains. But here's what I love about Joseph. He never abandoned the vision. Even in the prison, he carried himself like a king. Even in slavery, he operated with excellence. Even in the pit, he maintained his integrity. Why? Because he understood that the vision was not dependent on his circumstances. The vision was dependent on God's faithfulness. And after 13 years, let me repeat that. After 13 years of delay, disappointment, and difficulty, Genesis 41 tells us that in one day, everything changed. In one divine moment, Joseph went from the prison to the palace. In one supernatural intervention, he went from being a prisoner to being a PRIME MINISTER. ONE DAY, THAT'S ALL it took for God to complete what he had started. So, I'm prophesying over your life this morning. Your one day is here. Your suddenly is here. Your divine completion is here. What took years to delay will take moments to manifest. What the enemy thought he had destroyed, God is about to resurrect. What looked dead and buried, God is about to bring back to life. This is your season of divine completion. Now I want to pray militant prayer. I need you to stand on your feet if you can. I need you to engage. I need you to be violent in the spirit. The Bible says in Matthew 11:12, "And from the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven suffered violence and the violent take it by force." We are not playing church this morning. We are enforcing the victory of Jesus Christ. We are taking back what the enemy has stolen. We are possessing our possessions. Father, in the name of Jesus, I come against every demonic delay. I come against every satanic conspiracy. I come against every witchcraft manipulation. I come against every spirit of python that has been squeezing the life out of visions, I command you to lose your hold right now in the name of Jesus. Every serpent that has been coiled around destiny, I command you to uncoil and die. Every monitoring spirit that has been watching to abort completion, I command you to go blind right now. Every ancestral covenant that has been causing repetitive delays, I break your power by the blood of Jesus. I speak to every door that the enemy has shut. I decree, open now in the name of Jesus. Revelation 3:7 says, "And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia, write these things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that [music] had the key of David, he that openeth and no man shutth and shutth and no man openeth." I decree that Jesus is opening doors for you that no man can shut. Doors of [music] opportunity, doors of favor, doors of promotion, doors of breakthrough. I command every satanic agenda against your completion to be frustrated. Isaiah 8:10 says, "Take counsel together and it shall come to not. Speak the word and it shall not stand for God is with us." I decree that every counsel of the enemy against your life is coming to nothing. Every evil word spoken against your destiny is not standing. Every curse pronounced over your future is broken. You are hidden in Christ. You are covered by the blood. You are sealed by the spirit. I prophesy every good thing that died in your life is coming back to life. Every relationship that broke down is being restored. Every opportunity that passed you by is being recovered. The Bible says in Joel 2:25, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpillar and the palmer, my great army which I sent among you. I decree restoration. I decree recovery. I decree restitution. Everything the locust has eaten, God is bringing back multiplied. Now listen to me very carefully. Divine completion is not just about projects and visions. Divine completion is also about character. God is not just interested in what you do. He's interested in who you are. He wants to complete his work in you. He wants to transform you into the image of Christ. Romans 8:29 says, "For whom he did forno, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his son." God's ultimate goal is to make you like Jesus. And that is a process. That is a journey that requires patience, perseverance, and partnership with the Holy Spirit. You see, there are some people who want God to complete their projects, but they don't want God to complete their character. They want breakthrough, but they don't want transformation. They want promotion, but they don't want pruning. But let me tell you something. God will not promote what he has not perfected. He will not elevate what he has not matured. He will not position what he has not processed. The Bible says in 1 Peter 5:10, "But the God of all grace, who had called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, establish, strengthen, settle you." Did you see that? After you have suffered a while, not forever, just a while, God will make you perfect. The word perfect there [music] means complete, mature, fully developed. So every difficulty you're going through is not meant to destroy you. It's meant to develop you. Every challenge you're facing is not meant to break you. It's meant to build you. Every test you're enduring is not meant to defeat you. It's meant to promote you. I remember when I was going through a season of intense pruning in my own life, God was dealing with areas of pride, areas of self-reliance, areas where I was trusting in my own abilities rather than his grace. And it was painful. It was uncomfortable. There were moments I wanted to quit. There were moments I wanted to give up. But the Holy Spirit kept reminding me, "This is not punishment. This is preparation. This is not rejection. This is refinement. I'm completing the work. I started in you. And after that season of pruning, there was a season of promotion. After the wilderness, there was the promised land. After the valley, there was the mountaintop. After the testing, there was the testimony. So, I want to encourage somebody this morning. Don't despise the process. Don't resist the pruning. Don't run from the refining. God is completing his work in you. And when he's done, you're going to look back and say, "It was all worth it." Let me show you something powerful in the book of Neahhemiah. When Nehemiah was rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem, the enemy came with all kinds of opposition. Sambalat and Tobaya mocked him. They said, "What are these feeble Jews doing? Will they revive the stones out of the heaps of rubbish? They questioned his ability. They questioned his resources. They questioned his vision." But Nehemiah had a response. In Nehemiah 2:20, he said, "The God of heaven, he will prosper us." Therefore, we, his servants, will arise and build. Did you catch that? The God of heaven will prosper us. Not maybe, not hopefully, not possibly, will prosper us. That's the confidence of a man [music] who knows that divine completion is guaranteed. And despite all the opposition, despite all the mockery, despite all the challenges, the Bible tells us in Nehemiah 6:15, "So the wall was finished in the 20 and fifth day of the month, El 52 days." 52 days. A wall that had been broken down for years was rebuilt in 52 days. Why? Because when God is in it, completion is inevitable. I prophesy over [music] your life. What has been broken down for years, God is rebuilding in days. What has been in ruins, God is restoring. What has been in shambles, God is reconstructing. The walls of your finances are being rebuked. The walls of your health are being restored. The walls of your family are being reconstructed. The walls of your ministry are being reestablished. This is your season of divine reconstruction. Now, let me address something that the Holy Spirit is highlighting to me. There are some people who have been carrying the weight of guilt and condemnation because of past [music] failures. You started something and you quit. You made a vow and you broke it. You received the word and you doubted it. And now the enemy is telling you that it's too late. The enemy is telling you that you missed your opportunity. The enemy is telling you that God is disappointed in you. But I want you to hear this prophetic word. God is not done with you. Your past does not disqualify you from divine completion. The Bible says in Lamentations 3:22 23, "It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness." Every morning God's mercies are new. Every morning his compassions are fresh. Every morning he gives you another chance. Look at Peter. He denied Jesus three times. He cursed. He swore. He said, "I don't know the man. If anybody had a reason to believe they were disqualified, it was Peter." But what did Jesus do after his resurrection? He went looking for Peter. He restored Peter. He recommissioned Peter. And the same Peter who denied Jesus became the one who preached on the day of Pentecost and 3,000 souls were saved. The same Peter who failed became the one who wrote epistles that we still read today. Why? Because failure is not final when you serve a God of restoration. So I prophesy over [music] your life. You are not disqualified. You are not finished. You are not done. God is giving you another chance. He's restoring what was lost. He's renewing what was broken. He's reviving what looked dead. This is your season of divine restoration. Father, I pray for every person who has been carrying guilt and shame. I pray for every person who has been living under condemnation. I pray for every person who has been tormented by past mistakes. I decree the blood of Jesus is speaking better things. Hebrews 12:24 says, "We have come to Jesus, the mediator of the new covenant and to the blood of sprinkling that speaketh better things than that of Abel." The blood is speaking forgiveness. The blood is speaking redemption. The blood is speaking restoration. I decree that you are washed, you are cleansed, you are made whole. Every accusation of the devil, I silence it now. Revelation 12:10 calls him the accuser of our brethren. But the Bible also says in Romans 8:1, "There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the spirit. I decree no condemnation. You are free. You are forgiven. You are restored." Now let me bring this home with a powerful truth. Divine completion requires divine partnership. God will complete what he started [music] but you have a role to play. You have to stay in faith. You have to stay in obedience. You have to stay in alignment. Philippians 2:12:3 says, "Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence. Walk out your own salvation with fear and trembling. For it is God which walketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure." Did you see that? Walk out your own salvation. Not work for your salvation, but work out your salvation. In other words, cooperate with what God is doing in you. Partner with the Holy Spirit. Stay in the place of prayer. Stay in the word. Stay in fellowship. Stay in obedience. Because divine completion happens when heaven and earth agree. When God's will and your obedience come together, miracles happen. When divine purpose and human partnership align, the impossible becomes possible. So, I'm charging you this morning, don't give up. Don't quit. Don't abandon what God has called you to do. Galatians 6:9 says, "And let us not be weary in welloing, for in due season we shall reap if we faint not." If you faint not, that means you have to stay in the race. You have to keep pushing. You have to keep praying. You have to keep believing. Your reaping is connected to your not fainting. Your harvest is connected to your endurance. Your completion is connected to your consistency. I decree over your life, you will not faint, you will not quit. You will not give up. The grace to finish is resting upon you. The strength to complete is flowing through you. The anointing to persevere is operating [music] in you. You are crossing the finish line. You are completing the assignment. You are fulfilling your destiny. Let me pray one final prayer of completion over your life. Father in the mighty name of Jesus, I thank you for divine completion. I thank you that what you start you finish. I thank you that what you promise you perform. I thank you that what you decree you establish. So I stand in the gap for every person hearing this word and I decree this is their season of completion. Every unfinished chapter is being concluded. Every open matter is being closed in victory. Every pending issue is being had is solved in favor. I prophesy acceleration. What should take years will take months. What should take months will take weeks. What should take weeks will take days. God is compressing time on your behalf. He's releasing supernatural speed. He's causing things to suddenly align, suddenly come together, suddenly manifest. I speak to dry bones. I command leave. Ezekiel 37. I speak to dead situations. I command resurrect. John 11. I speak to impossible circumstances. I command turn around. Exodus 14. The God of suddenly is moving on your behalf. The God of turnarounds is working in your favor. The God of completion is finishing what he started. Receive it now in the name of Jesus. Your morning has divine completion written all over it. This day shall not pass without a testimony. This week shall not end without a breakthrough. This month shall not close without a miracle. I decree it. I establish it. I seal it in [music] Jesus mighty name. Good man.
